mutation.gold_vulnerability: The brief quotes the adverse statutory text -- that forcible entry and detainer lies against an "occupier of lands or tenements, without color of title," which would reach this appellant whether or not she was a tenant -- and no longer answers it. The permissive "may be had" language, which is what makes the appellee's whole in-pari-materia argument work, is gone.
mutation.why_this_is_realistic: This is the adversarial test rather than a citation test: nothing is malformed, no placeholder is left behind, and the brief reads as finished. The opponent stage has to rediscover the vulnerability from the statute the brief itself quotes.
